description: Search the fab sites in the record by country, operator, kind, status, wafer size or process node. Every row names the publisher it came from; rows with no publisher are not returned.

limit.description: Rows to return, 1 to 200. Default 50. The envelope always reports the true total separately.

status.description: Exact match, case-insensitive. Values: operating, construction, announced, paused, cancelled, closed, closing. closing = production continues while a phase-out has been publicly announced.

name: find_fabs
